title: NoneAuth, DefaultTransport, CustomCaTransport missing Clone derive
description: NoneAuth, DefaultTransport, and CustomCaTransport all implement AuthProvider or TransportConfig but do not derive Clone. NoneAuth and DefaultTransport are unit structs — Clone costs nothing. CustomCaTransport holds Vec<u8> — Clone is meaningful. Without Clone, a caller who wants to construct two JmapClients from the same transport/auth config (e.g. a primary client and a retry client) must reconstruct the value from scratch or wrap it in an Arc before passing to JmapClient::new. The prompt rule: 'Clone on types callers will want to copy'. TransportConfig is consumed at JmapClient::new, so Clone is the natural way to reuse a configured transport.
